exposure: Infants whose mothers gained greater amounts of weight during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women in a predominately lower income Hispanic pregnancy cohort in urban Los Angeles
finding: A doubling in hair arsenic was associated with a 72.2 g lower birth weight, after adjusting for potential confounders and gestational age at birth.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at biospecimen collection: 14 +/- 4 weeks
